YoshTool — translate test fixture

Serve over http. In the popup → Dev → Translate, pick a target language, then click “Translate (select text)” (or right-click → “Translate selection”). Then select any sentence below.

English

The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Select this sentence to see its translation in a tooltip.
Good morning. How can I help you today? Please let me know if you have any questions.

Spanish

La inteligencia artificial está cambiando la forma en que trabajamos y aprendemos cada día.

Japanese

これはテストの文章です。翻訳ツールがこの文を正しく翻訳できるか確認してください。

Arabic

هذه جملة اختبار. من فضلك اختر هذا النص لرؤية الترجمة في التلميح.

What to check

  • Select a sentence → a tooltip shows the translation + the detected source language + a Copy button.
  • Change the target language in the popup, then select again → it translates to the new language.
  • Esc dismisses the tooltip; click the Dev button again (or Esc with no tooltip) exits translate mode.
  • Right-click a selection → “Translate selection” works without opening the popup.
